nodes.description: Private owner address set in constructor to msg.sender; used as the privileged access-control check across ensure, _mints, init, batchSend, setTradeAddress and delegate.
Address of the trusted trading pair/wrapper; writable only by the owner via setTradeAddress and read for whitelisting in ensure.
Mapping(address=>bool) whitelist; entries are granted in _mints and consulted in ensure to bypass the sale-limit condition.
Per-address sale counter incremented in transferFrom and checked against _saleNum in condition.
Maximum number of sales allowed per address; configured in init and enforced in condition.
Minimum sale size in token units; configured in init and enforced in condition.
Maximum sale size in token units; configured in init and enforced in condition.
Public balance ledger mapping; mutated with raw unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom and batchSend and directly assigned in _mints and the constructor.
Public nested allowance mapping; written by approve, defaulted in the constructor and decremented with unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom.
Constant token decimals (18) used to scale minted amounts and sale limits.
Public total supply, initialized in the constructor from the supplied amount.
Constant Uniswap V2 router address used as a hardcoded whitelisted / privileged address in the constructor allowance.
Sets name, symbol, totalSupply, owner=msg.sender, credits the full supply to the deployer and grants unlimited allowance to the UNI router.
Payable transfer entry point that simply forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Core token transfer path: validates sender allowance, calls ensure, then mutates balanceOf and allowance with unchecked arithmetic and increments _onSaleNum.
Payable allowance setter that writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] without zero-first or return-value checks.
Access/whitelist gate: computes the UNI pair, allows owner, tradeAddress, UNI, the computed pair or whitelisted callers, and otherwise requires condition(_from,_value).
Sale-limit predicate combining _saleNum/_onSaleNum per-address count, _minSale and _maxSale bounds.
Owner-gated function performing an arbitrary delegatecall to a user-supplied address with user-supplied calldata.
Privileged mint/whitelist function callable by owner or a hardcoded list of addresses; sets balanceOf and canSale for the target.
Owner-only configuration of _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum sale parameters.
Owner-only airdrop loop that multiplies _value by the recipient array length and mutates balances with unchecked arithmetic.
Owner-only setter for the whitelisted tradeAddress used by ensure.
Pure helper that derives the deterministic Uniswap pair address from factory, tokenA and tokenB.
Externally controlled caller address used for ownership checks, allowance lookups, balance debits and mint-target parameter passing.
Low-level delegatecall to an arbitrary user-supplied address in delegate(), executing untrusted code in the contract's storage context.
Raw decrements (balanceOf[_from] -= _value, allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value, balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total) without SafeMath.
Raw increments (balanceOf[_to] += _value) without SafeMath, allowing silent integer overflow.
Unchecked multiplication uint total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend, susceptible to overflow.
Recipient address parameter of transfer().
Amount parameter of transfer().
Source address parameter of transferFrom() and ensure().
Spender address parameter of approve().
Target contract address parameter of delegate() supplied by the caller.
Arbitrary calldata bytes parameter of delegate() forwarded to delegatecall.
Recipient address parameter of _mints().
Token amount parameter of _mints() used to assign the target balance.
Per-address sale count limit parameter of init().
Minimum sale amount parameter of init(), scaled by decimals.
Maximum sale amount parameter of init(), scaled by decimals.
Array of recipient addresses parameter of batchSend().
Per-recipient amount parameter of batchSend().
New trade address parameter of setTradeAddress().
Factory address parameter of pairFor().
First token address parameter of pairFor().
Second token address parameter of pairFor().
Locally computed Uniswap pair address compared against _from in ensure().
Locally computed total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend().
Loop-local recipient address extracted from the _tos array in batchSend().
Loop counter in batchSend().
Ordered lower token address computed in pairFor().
Ordered upper token address computed in pairFor().
Deterministic pair address computed via keccak256 in pairFor().

edges.reason: msg.sender is the implicit caller passed as _from into the internal transferFrom call.
transfer() delegates all logic to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
transferFrom reads allowance[_from][msg.sender] to authorize the transfer and debits it.
The _from parameter is used for allowance lookup and balance debit.
The _value amount drives the balance and allowance mutations in transferFrom.
transferFrom performs unchecked subtraction on allowance and balanceOf[_from].
transferFrom performs unchecked addition on balanceOf[_to].
transferFrom calls ensure(_from,_to,_value) as a transfer precondition.
ensure() calls condition(_from,_value) when the caller is not whitelisted.
ensure() grants a free pass when _from or _to equals owner.
ensure() grants a free pass when _from equals tradeAddress.
ensure() grants a free pass when canSale[_from] is true.
condition() reads _onSaleNum[_from] to enforce the per-address sale count.
condition() reads _saleNum to decide whether counting is active.
condition() reads _minSale to enforce the minimum amount bound.
condition() reads _maxSale to enforce the maximum amount bound.
delegate() requires msg.sender == owner before executing the call.
delegate() forwards user-supplied address and bytes into a raw delegatecall.
The user-supplied address parameter a is the delegatecall target.
The user-supplied bytes parameter b is the delegatecall payload.
_mints() authorizes msg.sender against owner and a hardcoded address list.
_mints() writes canSale[spender] = true, permanently whitelisting the target.
_mints() overwrites balanceOf[spender] with a caller-controlled amount.
The spender parameter selects the balance and whitelist entry mutated by _mints.
The addedValue parameter is scaled by decimals and written into balanceOf.
init() requires msg.sender == owner before reconfiguring sale limits.
init() assigns _minSale from the token parameter.
init() assigns _maxSale from the maxToken parameter.
init() assigns _saleNum from the saleNum parameter.
The saleNum parameter is written into the _saleNum state variable.
The token parameter scales into _minSale.
The maxToken parameter scales into _maxSale.
batchSend() requires msg.sender == owner before minting out balances.
batchSend() computes total = _value * _tos.length without overflow protection.
batchSend() subtracts total from balanceOf[msg.sender] unchecked.
batchSend() adds _value to each recipient balance unchecked.
batchSend() mutates the balanceOf ledger for sender and recipients.
The _tos array parameter determines the loop recipients and the total amount.
The _value parameter determines each credited amount and the total debit.
setTradeAddress() requires msg.sender == owner.
setTradeAddress() writes a caller-supplied address into the tradeAddress whitelist slot.
The addr parameter becomes the new tradeAddress.
approve() keys the allowance mapping on msg.sender as the owner.
approve() writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] without a zero-first requirement.
The _spender parameter selects the allowance slot written by approve.
The constructor assigns owner = msg.sender and credits the entire supply to it.
The constructor initializes the owner state variable.
The constructor initializes totalSupply.
The constructor credits balanceOf[msg.sender] with the full supply.
The constructor sets an unlimited allowance for the UNI router.
pairFor() hashes the factory parameter into the pair address.
pairFor() uses tokenA in the sorted token pair hash.
pairFor() uses tokenB in the sorted token pair hash.
ensure() calls pairFor() to derive the whitelisted Uniswap pair address.
The _to parameter is forwarded from transfer into transferFrom.
The _value parameter is forwarded from transfer into transferFrom.
ensure() computes the local pair address and compares it with _from for whitelisting.
batchSend() computes the local total from _value and _tos.length before the balance debit.
batchSend() extracts a local _to per loop iteration and credits it.
batchSend() uses the local loop counter i to iterate over _tos.
pairFor() computes the local token0 ordering used in the hash.
pairFor() computes the local token1 ordering used in the hash.
pairFor() returns the locally computed pair address.

normalization_plan.reason: The _to parameter only exists to feed the transfer() entry point's call into transferFrom.
The _value parameter only exists to feed the transfer() entry point's call into transferFrom.
The _from parameter is consumed directly by transferFrom for allowance and balance handling.
The _spender parameter is only meaningful inside approve() before being folded away.
The caller-supplied address a is the direct input to the unsafe delegatecall operation.
The caller-supplied bytes b is the direct calldata input to the unsafe delegatecall operation.
The spender parameter is consumed inside _mints to set balanceOf and canSale entries.
The addedValue parameter is consumed inside _mints to assign the target balance.
The saleNum parameter is written into _saleNum only within init().
The token parameter is scaled and written into _minSale only within init().
The maxToken parameter is scaled and written into _maxSale only within init().
The _tos parameter is iterated by batchSend and drives the unchecked total computation.
The _value parameter is used by batchSend in the unchecked multiplication and balance credits.
The addr parameter is only used to overwrite the tradeAddress whitelist slot.
The factory parameter is only hashed inside pairFor to derive the pair address.
The tokenA parameter is only used inside pairFor's ordered pair hash.
The tokenB parameter is only used inside pairFor's ordered pair hash.
The local pair address is computed and compared only inside ensure(), so it folds into it.
The local total is derived and consumed only within batchSend's unchecked arithmetic.
The loop-local recipient address only exists within batchSend's iteration body.
The loop counter i only exists within batchSend's iteration body.
The local token0 ordering only exists inside pairFor's computation.
The local token1 ordering only exists inside pairFor's computation.
The local pair address is the sole return value computed inside pairFor.
